title: review: reviewer result
description: One reviewer's result. Strict-mode compatible (every property required, no additionalProperties, no numeric bounds); the coordinator checks ranges itself.

id.description: Reviewer id assigned in the prompt, e.g. R3.

area.description: Area name assigned in the prompt.

harness.description: Where this reviewer ran, e.g. claude-code subagent, codex, gemini, agy, sequential personas.

score.description: 0-10. 10 no findings above nit; 8-9 minors only; 6-7 one major; 3-5 several majors; 0-2 any blocker.

note.description: What was not reviewed and why. Empty string when complete.

unreadable.description: Every input you tried to open and could not (the prompt, the diff, a file). Empty when you read everything.

line.description: Line in the head version, >= 1. Null only when no single line applies; then evidence must carry a reproduction.

evidence.description: Quoted code and/or a concrete reproduction (input, call sequence, interleaving).

fix.description: One or two sentences describing the fix. No patch.

done.description: Exactly 'REVIEWED <id>', set last and only after you read your whole file list. Leave it empty if you could not read your inputs.
